description: Add a watcher to monitor a specific condition on a specific record and trigger a follow-up action
target_record: string (The Airtable record ID to watch, e.g., recXYZ)
condition_field: string (The Airtable field name to check, e.g., 'Status' or 'Payment Status')
condition_value: string (The value that triggers the action, e.g., 'Paid')
action_on_trigger: string (What PI should do when triggered, e.g., send_welcome_message)
